company.name: 1Password
company.shortDescription: A safe place to keep all your passwords, which fills them in for you on your phone and computer.
company.planHelp: Sign in at my.1password.com and open 'Billing'. It shows whether you are on the Individual or Families plan, what you pay and the renewal date.

features.label: People with their own private account
features.question: How many people need their own private password store?
features.help: On the Families plan each person gets their own locked account, and you can still share some passwords with each other.

features.label: Guest accounts for visitors
features.question: Do you need to share a few passwords with people outside your household, such as a cleaner or a house sitter?
features.help: A guest can see only the passwords you choose to share with them.

features.label: Sharing passwords with your family
features.question: Do you want to share some passwords with your spouse, partner, or family while keeping the rest private?

features.label: Help getting back in if you are locked out
features.question: Would you like a family member to be able to help you get back in if you forget your master password?
features.help: On the Families plan, family organizers can recover another member's account. On the Individual plan there is nobody who can do this for you.

features.label: Storage for documents
features.question: Do you also need somewhere safe to keep scanned documents such as your passport?
features.help: Both plans give 1 GB per person, which is plenty for documents.

plans.name: Individual
plans.bestFor: One person who just wants their own passwords kept safe and filled in automatically.
plans.notes: 1Password publishes this as '$3.99 USD per month' with annual billing; $47.88 is that figure multiplied by 12 (1Password does not print a yearly total on the page). PROMOTIONAL ONLY: new customers who subscribe directly at 1password.com with annual billing pay $2.99 a month for the first year ($35.88). The official fine print reads: 'Promotional pricing is available to new 1Password customers subscribing directly through 1Password.com only, for the first year with annual billing. Promotions are not available through Google Play, the Apple App Store, or other third-party app stores.' A month-by-month billing option is shown on the page but no month-by-month price is published, so no monthly price is recorded. 14-day free trial.

plans.name: Families
plans.bestFor: A couple or a family: up to 5 people, each with their own private store, plus shared passwords for things like the Wi-Fi and the streaming services.
plans.notes: 1Password publishes this as '$5.99 USD per month' with annual billing; $71.88 is that figure multiplied by 12 (no yearly total is printed on the page). PROMOTIONAL ONLY: $4.49 a month for the first year for new customers buying direct with annual billing ($53.88). Includes 5 family members and 5 guest accounts; extra members can be added for a further fee. Adds unlimited shared vaults, permission controls and the ability for family organizers to recover a member's account. 14-day free trial.

faq.q: What is the difference between Individual and Families?
faq.a: Individual is one account for one person. Families covers up to 5 people, each with their own private store that nobody else can see, plus shared areas for passwords the household uses together, such as the Wi-Fi and the television services.

faq.q: What happens if I forget my master password?
faq.a: On the Families plan another family organizer can help you get back in. On the Individual plan there is no one who can do that for you, so keep your Emergency Kit somewhere safe.

faq.q: Will the price go up after the first year?
faq.a: Yes, if you took the introductory offer. The regular prices are $3.99 a month for Individual and $5.99 a month for Families when paid yearly.

faq.q: Does 1Password sell a plan for a small business?
faq.a: Yes. 1Password also sells Teams and Business plans, but those are work plans rather than household plans and their prices are not recorded here.

notes: Prices verified from 1password.com/pricing/personal on 2026-09-21 and stated by 1Password as per-month figures with annual billing; the annual totals here are those figures multiplied by 12. A monthly billing toggle exists on the page but 1Password does not publish a month-to-month price, so no 'monthly' price is recorded for either plan. Teams Starter Pack and Business plans exist but are work plans and are deliberately excluded from this consumer file.
